stemMd: Two independent events have probabilities P(U) = 0.4 and P(V) = 0.3. What is the probability that exactly one occurs?
explanationMd: Exactly one means U without V or V without U. Independence gives 0.4 × 0.7 + 0.3 × 0.6 = 0.28 + 0.18 = 0.46. As a check, neither (0.42), exactly one (0.46) and both (0.12) sum to one.

distractorRationale.e: This adds the probabilities but includes the overlap twice.
distractorRationale.a: This is the probability both occur.
distractorRationale.d: This is the probability at least one occurs.
distractorRationale.b: This is the probability neither occurs.
